verdict.rationale: Kit's API is explicitly versioned (the docs reference the "V4 API"), and an official guide covers upgrading from V3 to V4, which shows managed version transitions. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, support windows or deprecation notices. Missing for 10: a published deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, documented V3 end-of-life terms, changelog or version-header mechanics, and independent corroboration.
